title: My Weekend Hobbies
text:
I like sports very much. On Saturday, I play football with my friends in the park. We play for one hour and then we rest.

On Sunday, I paint pictures at home. I like to paint the sea and the sky. My brother likes music, so he plays the guitar every evening.

questions.text: What sport does the person play on Saturday?
Where does the person play football?
What can we guess about the brother?
options: He plays football with the person

vocabulary.definition: a sport played by two teams who try to kick a ball into a goal
a public green area where people can walk, play and relax
a musical instrument with six strings that you play with your fingers

paragraph_translations: Me gusta mucho el deporte. El sábado juego al fútbol con mis amigos en el parque. Jugamos durante una hora y luego descansamos.
El domingo pinto cuadros en casa. Me gusta pintar el mar y el cielo. Mi hermano le gusta la música, así que toca la guitarra todas las tardes.
